content:
SimpleGraph/Clique.lean contains 8 definitions about cliques and 8 matching definitions about independent sets, and many theorems about cliques aren't duplicated for independent sets.

I found 118 decls which seem to be missing a dual.

list

The 8 defs:

IsClique ↔ IsIndepSet
IsNClique ↔ IsNIndepSet
IsMaximumClique ↔ IsMaximumIndepSet
CliqueFree ↔ IndepSetFree
CliqueFreeOn ↔ IndepSetFreeOn
cliqueSet ↔ indepSetSet
cliqueNum ↔ indepNum
cliqueFinset ↔ indepSetFinset

We could add all of these and keep the API synced manually, but we could also try to use a translation attribute, like @[to_dual].

#45224 adds @[to_compl] and tags some of these to autogenerate the independent set version. Wdyt?
(imagine that this attribute is somehow local to the Clique.lean file rather than defined globally, or at least with a more specific name such as to_simple_graph_compl)

@[to_dual] itself won't work because it already has a translation dictionary with lots of registered lemmas that reverse the direction of ≤, so I think we need a clean one.
Not every theorem could be translated. Sometimes this is because the clique version has ¬G.Adj u v which could become G.Adj u v (if we know u ≠ v) but translating it gives ¬Gᶜ.Adj u v.
